G1.visual: Ripple ring from the touch point with a bright core dot. Ring expands to about 120 pt, ease-out, about 0.6 s.

G2.visual: A second, larger ring chases the first, plus a brief flash at the center. Rings reach about 250 pt; the second starts about 80 ms after the first.

G3.visual: Particle burst (about 24 particles) outward, with a ring. Particles fly out with drag and fade.

G4.visual: Ring pulses at the last tap point, repeating at the tapped tempo. Keeps pulsing about 8 s, each pulse slightly dimmer; tapping elsewhere moves it.

G5.visual: Glow pools under the finger and grows into a soft orb. Orb grows and slowly breathes; faint particles drift inward.
G5.inherits: Hold time sets orb size and brightness

G6.visual: Orb releases as a shockwave ring. Expands fast then slows; strength scales with hold time (capped around 2 s).

G7.visual: Ink line with a soft glow, tapered ends and a brighter sparkle at the stroke head. Line thins as speed rises; the head sparkle trails slightly behind the finger.

G8.visual: Stroke detaches and keeps flying as a comet. Carries momentum, slows with drag, bounces softly off screen edges, then fades.

G9.visual: Ink under the scribble dissolves into particles (works as an eraser). Particles drift upward and fade as the scribble passes over them.
G9.inherits: Scribble area; speed sets dissolve rate

G10.visual: Loop snaps into a clean ring and sends out 3 concentric echo rings; the ring stays as ink. Echoes expand and fade about 150 ms apart.

G11.visual: Inward: nearby ink and particles are pulled into a vortex that ends in a flash. Outward: a swirl bursts away from the center.
G11.inherits: Direction and number of turns set intensity

G12.visual: Stroke turns into a jagged electric arc with small branching sparks. Arc flickers and crackles for about 1 s.

G13.visual: Anchor at the first tap with an elastic line to the finger. Line stretches and glows; on release it snaps back and launches particles toward the anchor.

G14.visual: The glowing orb follows the finger and pulls nearby particles along; nearby ink is tugged. Pulled items lag with spring physics; tugged ink springs back to rest on release.

G15.visual: Ink blooms at that point like a blot soaking into paper. Blot grows while you dwell, with soft feathered edges.

G16.visual: Two ripples linked by a glowing filament that pulses once. Filament brightens as the rings expand.
G16.inherits: Distance between fingers sets filament length and ring size

G17.visual: A ribbon fills the space between the fingers, with a gradient edge. Ribbon width follows the finger gap and stretches or twists as it changes.

G18.visual: Nearby ink and particles are pulled toward the pinch center, with a flash when the pinch finishes. Compression speeds up as the fingers close; the finish is a quick implosion.
G18.inherits: Pinch speed sets pull and flash strength

G19.visual: Shockwave expands from the center; nearby ink ripples like water. Ink wobbles outward, then springs back to rest.

G20.visual: Swirl field around the midpoint; particles orbit and ink twists slightly. Keeps spinning with momentum after release, then slows to a stop.

G21.visual: Held finger glows as a core; the orbiting finger leaves a circular trail that becomes a ring. Particles keep orbiting the core for a few seconds after release.

G22.visual: Tap: three linked ripples form a triangle. Swipe: a wave sweeps across the screen in the swipe direction; it nudges ink slightly and fades at the far edge.

G23.visual: Large splash from the center point of the fingers, with a brief full-canvas flash. Big radial burst (more particles than G3) and a subtle screen pulse.

G24.visual: Gather: all ink on screen is sucked into one glowing orb at the center. Spread: the orb explodes outward and the ink is restored.

G25.visual: Ripples hop between the touch points, linked by thin lightning-like lines. Each hop gets brighter as the tempo rises.
G25.inherits: Tempo sets brightness and chain length

G26.visual: One ink line per finger, with a faint shimmer between the lines. Lines keep the finger spacing; the shimmer travels with the stroke heads.

G27.visual: The stroke rings like a plucked string; a glow travels both ways from the touch point. Wave decays along the stroke; the stroke wobbles, then returns to rest.
G27.inherits: Tap position sets wave origin; stroke length sets ring time

G28.visual: Spark burst at the crossing; the older stroke ripples briefly. Sparks fly off along both stroke directions.

G29.visual: Glow floods into the enclosed area from the closing point. Flood spreads fast, then settles to a faint pulse; the fill stays.
G29.inherits: Area sets flood time; draw speed sets brightness

G30.visual: Edge glows like a bumper and a wave pushes in from that edge. Wave travels about a third of the screen; nearby ink ripples.

G31.visual: A soft halo blooms at the lift point and fades. Bloom size follows speed at lift; fast lifts leave a short trail.
G31.inherits: Speed at lift sets size and trail

G32.visual: Canvas breathes: faint drifting motes, ink shimmers softly, everything dims after about 30 s. Very slow motion, with the frame rate throttled to save battery.
G32.inherits: Existing ink and the last touch location
